source_contract.source_rule: The final OpenPI training batch is padded by PadStatesAndActions to config.model.action_dim; data_loader_test asserts actions.shape == (batch_size, action_horizon, action_dim).

interpretation: The 23-dimensional R1Pro action vector is the pre-padding robot-space representation. The final pi0.5 training batch is correctly padded to 32 dimensions. The repair1 smoke failed because its assertion checked the wrong representation layer; the decoded batch itself is not evidence of data drift.
allowed_repair: Change only the zero-update smoke assertion to validate the final model-space state/action dimensions against cfg.model.action_dim=32. Keep FFmpeg runtime, batch16, data, ordering, checkpoint, seed, normalization, tokenizer, GPU and zero-update boundary unchanged.
